description: This file defines an API router using FastAPI for authentication endpoints including user registration, login, logout, and retrieving current user info.

methods.name: Any register(payload: UserCreate, auth_service: AuthService = Depends(get_auth_service))
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password.

methods.name: Any login(payload: UserLogin, response: Response, auth_service: AuthService = Depends(get_auth_service))
methods.description: Logs in a user, sets a JWT cookie, and returns user info.

methods.name: None logout(response: Response)
methods.description: Logs out a user by clearing the authentication cookie.

methods.name: Any me(user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves information about the currently authenticated user.
